entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return a helmet.
Okay, I can certainly look into that for you. To start, could you help me understand what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
The color is wrong. It's not what I wanted.
I see. Just to confirm, you'd like to return it because of the color. Let me pull up your account here... One moment. Okay, I see the order. It looks like it was delivered about 35 days ago.
Yes. The box is unopened. It should be fine.

It absolutely is. According to our policy for standard items like this, you are well within the 90-day return window. Your satisfaction and safety are our top priorities, so if the color isn't right for you, we can definitely get that processed.
Fine. So what do I do?

I've just initiated the return and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on file. You can simply print that out, attach it to the original packaging, and drop the helmet off at your local post office. Once our warehouse receives it, a full refund will be issued to your original payment method.
Great. Was there anything else I could assist you with today?
Alright. Well, thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great rest of your day.
